topics.title: Basic Controls
topics.text: Move with A and D or the arrow keys, and jump with Space or W. Click the left mouse button to attack. When a prompt appears over a person or an object, press E to talk, open or pick it up.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu.

topics.title: The Map
topics.text: The minimap in the top right shows the rooms around you. Open the full map to see everything you have explored so far; while it is open, the arrow keys move the view and you stand still.
topics.hint: Button to open or close the full map.

topics.title: Saving Your Progress
topics.text: Look for save points along the way. Step up to one and choose a save slot — there are four. To pick up where you left off, choose Continue on the title screen.
topics.hint: Button at a save point to save your game.

topics.title: The Journal
topics.text: The Journal in the game menu follows the story. Each part of the Prologue lists its objectives as you reach them, and opening a part tells what has happened there so far.
topics.hint: Button to open the game menu, then choose Journal.
